22 def _get_setting_callback(req: GetSettingsRequest) -> GetSettingsResponse:
23  resp = system_api_client.get_setting(req.name)
24  if not resp.success:
25  return GetSettingsResponse(status=CommandStatus.SYSTEM_API_CLIENT_REQUEST_FAILED, value=resp.detail)
26  return GetSettingsResponse(status=CommandStatus.SUCCESS, type=resp.data['type'], value=resp.data[req.name])
27 
28 
29 def _set_setting_callback(req: SetSettingsRequest) -> SetSettingsResponse:
30  resp = system_api_client.set_setting(req.name, req.value)
31  status = CommandStatus.SUCCESS if resp.success else CommandStatus.SYSTEM_API_CLIENT_REQUEST_FAILED
32  return SetSettingsResponse(status=status, message=resp.detail)
